# TrustGraph.de

Independent reference on trust, authority, and evidence relationships in machine-consumable systems.

## Canonical Resource

[Home](https://trustgraph.de/)

## Purpose

TrustGraph documents how claims, evidence, and source anchors can be structured into traceable relationships, with a focus on inspectability, provenance, and integrity.

## Repository

[TrustGraph Evidence Repository](https://github.com/semantic-infrastructure/trustgraph-evidence)
